596b455186f77457cb50eccb description: Ah, it's you again. Decided to hang on tight to me then, ye? Bloody awesome. I need to stir up some movement in our region. All sorts of outsiders keep popping up meddling with business, shoot, loot valuables off my guys, whack them indiscriminately. That makes me kinda unhappy, so to say, and it does not fall in line with my business concept. And to make it clear that they're in deep shit, fuck them up with pistols, let them understand that the pros are working. Well, go on and rake them "operators" of yours, and I’ll pay the bounty for each head, and even something extra as a present on top. Times are hard, and you have to make a living here somehow - preferably a good one.
596b455186f77457cb50eccb successMessageT: Ah-hah, now that was a stirrup if I ever seen one! I got word from all channels that some devil is at large and grounded quite a bunch of people. You rock, get your reward.
5c0bd94186f7747a727f09b2 description: Greetings! Here's the deal, I've ordered a bunch of western guns from Mechanic for my clients. Guns are foreign-made, I'm way keener on the Fatherland-made guns, native product is way closer to the old soldier's soul and all. So, the gun is an SR-25 with a Hybrid 46 silencer and a Schmidt & Bender PM II 1-8x24 scope, and I need you to give it a hard ride in action. And there's no way you just shoot some Scavs and call it a day, you will have to give it some real deal. I will give you one of these rifles, you watch after it! They cost a fortune, so if you lose it - that's your problem.
5c0bd94186f7747a727f09b2 successMessageT: So, what do you think? Some serious toy, yeah? Great, hand it over then. Here, that's for the help. Keep in touch, I might need more help to test some other things.
5c1234c286f77406fa13baeb description:
Hello, buddy. You heard about the Scavs squaring off right now, right? It's a big mess out there. And it's all fine and dandy, but my boys are getting caught up in this as well. Though my guys are not complete nitwits, some help would still be appreciated.

So here's the plan: this gang has their own outfits, their key-fighters wear ushankas, fisherman vests, and carry classic scav-issue weapons. What a bunch of clowns, aren't they? So what you should do is dress up like one of them (Scav Vest, Ushanka ear flap hat, and a scav-issue weapon) and smoke some PMCs. I don't care about factions, the important thing is to just get PMCs into this to fight those morons. You get what's gonna happen, yeah?
5c1234c286f77406fa13baeb successMessageT: My guys are saying that Customs is at World War 3 right now, BEARs and USECs are dropping Scavs left and right! Good shit, nice work. Here's your prize, as promised.
63a5cf262964a7488f5243ce description: Greetings! Well, let's get it going, are you excited? The task is quite specific, we need to test an MP5SD with an Aimpoint PRO sight for close combat, so that the conditions were the very real combat in urban environment. Streets of Tarkov, Interchange, and Ground Zero. I have customers who don't believe in the effectiveness of this toy... Can you change their minds?
63a5cf262964a7488f5243ce successMessageT: Well? Does it work good? Suitable for close-quarters combat in urban environments?
64f5deac39e45b527a7c4232 description: No shortage of patriots... I had a conversation with a group of BEARs the other day, we chatted about domestic weapons. Anyway, a new AK has arrived in stock, I need to test it somewhere... Lighthouse, Customs, and Reserve should do. Alrighty, here's your build, go operate!
64f5deac39e45b527a7c4232 successMessageT: Of course it works! Thanks for the help, soldier.
6574e0dedc0d635f633a5805 description: I've got a new toy I've been thinking about testing out. And here you are, just in time for this. Take this RPD and go to Shoreline, Woods, and Interchange, shoot with it there. Just don't lose it on the way there, I won't accept any other guns.
6574e0dedc0d635f633a5805 successMessageT: So how do you like it, good, yeah? It's a real beauty in combat!
669fa3a40c828825de06d6a1 description:

I got a new one, albeit imported. Lightweight, easy to handle. That's something our guns sometimes lack.

We need to test this SR-2M with a KP-SR2 sight in close quarters within kissing distance, hehe. Factory would be perfect for this. Let me know how it goes.
669fa3a40c828825de06d6a1 successMessageT: How's it feel, easy to aim? Does the silencer get in the way? Okay, I'm convinced. Only a fool would turn down a good weapon.
